_meta.description: Machine-readable index of every module in the NCE Sync (Tables) Frappe app. Read this file FIRST before exploring the codebase — it tells you exactly where to look for any given concern.
_meta.usage: Find the module whose 'purpose' matches your task, then read only that file and its 'depends_on' entries. Run `python scripts/build_code_index.py --write` to regenerate CODE_INDEX.json after editing this file or after adding/renaming/deleting source files.

architecture.overview: NCE Sync (app_title: Tables) synchronises WordPress database tables to Frappe custom doctypes. It mirrors WordPress table schemas as Frappe doctypes, then syncs data bidirectionally. Also provides a Table Links page for managing cross-table relationships and an NCE Access Profile doctype that maps a linked Role to per-DocType read/write via Custom DocPerm. Used as a dependency by NCE Events.
architecture.data_flow: WordPress MySQL → schema_mirror.py (introspect + create/update Frappe doctype) → data_sync.py (pull WP rows → upsert Frappe records) | Frappe doc events → live_sync.py → write_back_dispatch.run_write_back_for_doc (SQL Direct only) → push_record_to_wp → WordPress; reverse_sync.py for bulk Frappe→WP
key_patterns: WP_Tables doctype is the central config record per synced table (connection, column mapping, matching keys, field overrides, write_back_mode, listen_for_changes)
schema_mirror.py introspects WP table schema and creates/updates Frappe custom doctype
data_sync.py does incremental sync using modified timestamp cutoff; per-row DB savepoints so one bad row does not abort the whole batch; row_hint in skip_errors for debugging
live_sync.py hooks into Frappe doc events; enqueues run_write_back_for_doc on the default queue; uses frappe.flags.in_sync during WP→Frappe saves to avoid feedback loops
write_back_dispatch.run_write_back_for_doc runs SQL Direct write-back only (lazy import of push_record_to_wp); custom API flows use Client Script on the target DocType
reverse_sync.py handles full Frappe-to-WP push with temp name management

NCE Access Profile: Table Access grid (read/write/restrict_write per DocType) is synced to Custom DocPerm for the linked role on Save / Apply Access; that role's permissions are managed ONLY via this profile, not hand-edited in Role Permission Manager
API Connector stores credentials (base_url, auth_pattern, credential_config JSON)
Job queuing: scheduled sync, manual sync (WP Tables / Sync Manager), Excel export API, and live write-back all use frappe.enqueue(..., queue="default") so a single worker processes jobs in order

nce_sync/hooks.py.purpose: App config: metadata, CSS/JS includes, apps screen registration (title: Tables, route: /app/tables)

nce_sync/api.py.purpose: Whitelisted endpoints: toggle auto-sync, table links grid, Excel export; sync_doctype_rows / sync_linked_doctype_rows enqueue WP sync jobs (job_id, optional debug_trace → step log + copyable dialog and logger nce_sync.sync_trace)

nce_sync/overrides.py.purpose: Frappe lifecycle override hooks injected via hooks.py

nce_sync/utils/schema_mirror.py.purpose: WordPress schema introspection and Frappe doctype mirroring: connect to WP MySQL, discover tables/views, map MariaDB types to Frappe types, create or update Frappe custom doctype with matching field configuration. Remap/update preserves hand-built form layout (Tab/Section/Column breaks); new WP columns append under shared New fields tab. Preview syncs column_mapping flags from live DocType before Remap dialog. Supports read_only, bold, pick_list, virtual/generated columns via sql_to_python.

nce_sync/utils/sql_to_python.py.purpose: Translate MySQL/MariaDB GENERATION_EXPRESSION SQL into Python expressions for Frappe virtual DocField options. Output must use ONLY Frappe safe_eval allowed names (int, float, round, attribute access, operators, string methods, None/True/False). Handles CONCAT, CONCAT_WS, IFNULL/COALESCE, UPPER/LOWER, TRIM, LEFT/RIGHT, YEAR/MONTH, ROUND, and arithmetic. Uses (x or '') for None-safe string coercion — str()/cstr()/getattr() are NOT available in the sandbox.

nce_sync/utils/data_sync.py.purpose: WP-to-Frappe incremental data sync: fetch changed rows since last sync timestamp, upsert Frappe records, publish progress events. Uses per-row savepoints in batch upsert and truncate-replace so validation/DB errors on one row roll back only that row; remaining rows commit. Sets frappe.flags.in_sync while saving mirrored docs so live_sync does not enqueue write-back during inbound sync. _convert_row skips virtual/generated columns (no Frappe DB column).
private_helpers: row-level savepoint/rollback pattern (row_sync) with row_hint in skip_errors

nce_sync/utils/sync_trace.py.purpose: Optional PerfTrace for queued sync jobs when API debug is truthy; logs logger nce_sync.sync_trace and pushes copyable Desk msgprint (wide pre)

nce_sync/utils/live_sync.py.purpose: Real-time Frappe→WordPress write-back entry point: wildcard on_update/after_insert handler. If frappe.flags.in_sync, returns (WP→Frappe sync in progress). Else if DocType is in listen map, enqueues run_write_back_for_doc on queue default. Implements push_record_to_wp for SQL Direct path (used via lazy import from write_back_dispatch).
sections: Default queue coordination with data_sync jobs

nce_sync/utils/write_back_dispatch.py.purpose: Background job target: if WP Tables has listen_for_changes and write_back_mode SQL Direct, lazy-imports push_record_to_wp from live_sync (avoids circular import).

nce_sync/utils/reverse_sync.py.purpose: Full Frappe-to-WP bulk sync: inserts new records and updates existing ones in WP, handles temp name assignment for new Frappe records before WP ID is known

nce_sync/utils/workspace_utils.py.purpose: Frappe Workspace creation/management utilities for NCE Sync

nce_sync/utils/column_mapper.py.purpose: Column mapping helpers between WP table columns and Frappe doctype fields.

nce_sync/utils/connections.py.purpose: WordPress/MySQL connection helpers — resolve a WP Connection doc into a live DB handle.

nce_sync/utils/constants.py.purpose: Shared constants for NCE Sync (fieldtype maps, skip sets, defaults).

nce_sync/utils/derived_column_sql.py.purpose: Build SQL for derived/generated columns used in schema mirroring and sync.

nce_sync/utils/lock_check.py.purpose: Pre-flight lock checks before long-running sync jobs (detect blocker threads / abort safely).

nce_sync/utils/script_default_validation.purpose: Validate script default values for DocType fields (safe_eval constraints).

nce_sync/utils/sync_gate.py.purpose: Sync gate flag helpers (is_doctype_syncing) used to suppress live write-back during inbound sync.

nce_sync/public/js/list_auto_size.js.purpose: Global JS — auto-sizes list view columns for better readability

nce_sync/public/js/table_links_self_link.purpose: Desk-wide patch that replaces Table Links diagonal dash cells with Link/checkmark buttons when a cached page script still draws the old self-link lockout.

nce_sync/tests/test_derived_column_sql.p.purpose: Unit tests for derived/generated column SQL building.

nce_sync/tests/test_forced_read_only.py.purpose: Unit tests for forced read-only field handling in schema mirror / sync.

nce_sync/tests/test_live_sync_delete.py.purpose: Unit tests for live_sync on_record_delete behaviour (Frappe→WP delete propagation).

nce_sync/tests/test_remap_layout_preserv.purpose: Unit tests that schema Remap preserves hand-built form layout (Tab/Section/Column breaks).

nce_sync/tests/test_script_default_valid.purpose: Unit tests for script default value validation.

nce_sync/nce_sync/doctype/wp_tables/.purpose: Central config per synced WordPress table: WP connection, table name, Frappe doctype name, column mapping, matching keys, field overrides, timestamp fields, auto-sync, listen_for_changes, write_back_mode. Schema preview dialog + main form Field Reference tab show mandatory/read-only/data type and write-back exclusion per column. sync_now enqueues run_sync_for_table on queue default.
client_js: wp_tables.js (form actions, Field Reference tab on main form, schema preview dialog tabs, resizable 95vw modal)

nce_sync/nce_sync/doctype/wordpress_conn.purpose: WordPress MySQL connection config: host, port, database, user, password. Test connection button in form.

nce_sync/nce_sync/doctype/api_connector/.purpose: External API connector config: base_url, auth_pattern, credential_config (JSON). Used by NCE Events for credentials.py lookup.

nce_sync/nce_sync/doctype/api_connector_.purpose: Individual API endpoint definition linked to an API Connector

nce_sync/nce_sync/doctype/sync_manager/.purpose: Batch sync manager — trigger and monitor sync across multiple WP Tables; enqueues one run_sync_for_table job per table on queue default

nce_sync/nce_sync/doctype/sync_log/.purpose: Log of each sync run: table, rows processed, errors, status

nce_sync/nce_sync/doctype/sync_log_row_e.purpose: Child table of Sync Log — one row per failed row in a sync batch (row hint + error).

nce_sync/nce_sync/doctype/nce_access_pro.purpose: Maps a profile name to a linked Role (NCE {profile}) and a Table Access grid of per-DocType read/write/restrict_write. Save/Apply Access syncs the grid to Custom DocPerm for that role and clears cache. Manage Fields toggles per-field Restricted (permlevel 1) app-wide via Property Setter; Manage Users invites/assigns/removes users on the role. Whitelisted: apply_access, get_doctype_fields, set_field_restricted, set_all_fields_restricted, get_profile_users, add_user_to_profile, remove_user_from_profile, invite_user_to_profile.
client_js: nce_access_profile.js (Apply Access + Manage Users buttons, Manage Fields grid cells)

nce_sync/nce_sync/doctype/nce_access_pro.purpose: Child table of NCE Access Profile — one row per DocType: document_type, read, write, restrict_write, manage_fields.

nce_sync/nce_sync/page/nce_sync/.purpose: Main NCE Sync dashboard page — table list, sync triggers, status display

nce_sync/nce_sync/page/table_links/.purpose: Table Links page — visual grid for managing Link relationships between WP Tables DocTypes, including same-table (self) relations on the diagonal
